posts.text:
SHARP: “Every single Republican voted against Massie’s amendment and voted to give aid to Israel. 

Why is it only Democrats that [Massie] can work with on this?”

GAETZ: “Republicans are concerned what might happen to them after watching what happened to Thomas Massie. 

Thomas Massie just had tens of millions of dollars dumped on his head in Kentucky and lost a district that he had won for more than a decade. 

I think it is a function of political fear.”

WATCH The Anchormen NOW: piped.video/
